group.description: Four UCI cohorts as four hospitals; every decision made by the agents live

task_spec.question: Does this patient have angiographic heart disease?

input_schema.name: cp
input_schema.unit: 1 typical angina, 2 atypical angina, 3 non-anginal pain, 4 asymptomatic

input_schema.name: restecg
input_schema.unit: 0 normal, 1 ST-T wave abnormality, 2 left ventricular hypertrophy

input_schema.name: oldpeak
input_schema.description: ST depression induced by exercise relative to rest

input_schema.name: slope
input_schema.description: slope of the peak exercise ST segment

input_schema.name: ca
input_schema.description: number of major vessels coloured by fluoroscopy
